mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in GDP indicates strong economic growth, which positively impacts corporate earnings and drives up S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: GDP growth is positive, but S&P 500 returns are negative over the 60-day horizon in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in unemployment rate above 4.5% signals labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as investor confidence drops.
failure_condition: UNRATE rises above 4.5%, but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production and payroll employment both show strong growth, it indicates a robust economy, leading to positive S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: Both INDPRO and PAYEMS show growth, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, increased federal funds rate leads to higher borrowing costs, negatively impacting S&P 500 returns over 60 days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS increases by 0.5%, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in CPI suggests inflationary pressures, which can negatively impact corporate margins and S&P 500 returns in the short term.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5%, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong consumer demand in the housing market, which positively impacts related sectors and S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST increases by more than 5%, but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in retail sales suggests weakening consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns as companies face reduced revenues.
failure_condition: RSAFS decreases by more than 1%, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment combined with high inflation indicates a overheating economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 returns as the Fed may tighten policy.
failure_condition: UNRATE is low and CPIAUCSL is high, but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 30% of cases.
